_comment: Compare pairs Google has indexed. generateStaticParams builds the top-5-per-concern combinations, and the August scoring rebuild moved products out of those top fives, which turned already-indexed compare URLs into hard 404s (dynamicParams=false). These are the pairs the 2026-09-30 Coverage export still lists, with what the 2026-09-23 Performance export says they were earning. Pairs are kept only while both products remain in the catalogue. Add to this list rather than widening the top-N, which would generate hundreds of pages nobody asked for.
